title: Private open space per apartment: minimum area (Table 1.1a), R30 to R60
text: Primary garden area. C1.1.1 A minimum of one private open space area is provided for the exclusive use of each dwelling, in accordance with Table 1.1a. Table 1.1a Primary garden area provisions. Minimum private open space area (m2 per dwelling): Studio/1 bedroom 8m2; 2 bedrooms 10m2; 3 or more bedrooms 12m2; Ground floor dwelling 15m2. When calculating the extent of private open space for apartments, exclude service areas such as bin storage, clothes drying, air conditioning units and the like.

replaces.note: Part C multiple dwelling balcony or equivalent

notes: from: ch3 C1.1.3. diverges: one private open space per apartment sized by dwelling size (Table 1.1a, p9: studio/1 bed 8 m2, 2 bed 10 m2, 3+ bed 12 m2, ground floor 15 m2) in place of the grouped PGA by site area; no secondary POS reduction (ch3 C1.1.4 has no equivalent). Fact describes the least compliant apartment against Table 1.1a (p9) and its size category (studio_1bed, 2bed, 3bed_plus, ground_floor; proposed fact). Service areas (bin storage, clothes drying, air conditioning units and the like) are excluded from the POS area. Table 1.1a is titled 'Primary garden area provisions', a misnomer for apartments (C4P1-004, C4P1-005).
